top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength lattice is a simple, general mechanism (vanishing differential light shift) that turns a single-particle measurement into a many-atom one, was reproduced across several independent laboratories at the 10^-18 level, and has produced new observations. The Katori and Ye allocation is uncontested and the citation can be scoped to what has been demonstrated; remaining priority questions (Lemonde, Pottier) do not justify withholding the prize.
